contract.storage: Bounded public data records preserve canonical layout, field ownership and the native ABI; scoped and fixed-underlying enums, C/C++ linkage and overloads participate in identity.
contract.identity: Exact language, standard, Blocks mode, ownership, runtime, target, compiler patch and semantic-capability locks. Actual target AST settings must match the prepared import session. ABI 12 requires rebuilding every object and semantic interface.
contract.imports: C++20 preprocessing defers registered source imports to Sema while preserving native module loading for unregistered names. Multiplexed semantic providers forward claims and errors without leaking nonclaiming candidates. Eager API imports merge after the compiler ARC prelude; source imports preserve position-sensitive visibility and module-qualified overload lookup.
boundaries: records with bases, explicit special members, methods, private fields, member initializers or nested declarations
default arguments, inline definitions and constant-expression exports
cross-language, cross-standard and cross-ownership interface reinterpretation
public Optional/Result, synchronous throws, async/await and actors remain reserved

sanitizers.instrumentation: consumer, native fixture, and provider fixtures; SDK runtime loaded as shipped

record_regression_sanitizers.instrumentation: consumer, native fixture, and provider fixtures; SDK runtime loaded as shipped

cxx_interface_sanitizers.instrumentation: consumer, native and provider fixtures; SDK runtime loaded as shipped
